title: Postal address
description:
One structured postal address, usable in every country. Field names are the ISO 19160-1 / libaddressinput set and map one-to-one onto FHIR R4 Address, so an address stored here needs no per-country translation to be exported. Which of these fields a given country uses, requires, uppercases and what it calls them comes from shared/address-formats/address-formats.v1.json — this schema deliberately requires only the country, because there is no other field every country has.

This describes the address of a facility, never of a person: there is no recipient or attention line, and none should be added. Personal addresses are outside what this software stores.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3. The key into the address-format pack, and the only universally present field. Maps to FHIR Address.country.

address_lines.description: Street-level lines in the order the country writes them, in the local script. Never parsed into components — no parsing rule holds across countries. Maps to FHIR Address.line[].

dependent_locality.description: Neighbourhood, township, townland or sub-city area, where the country has one. Maps to FHIR Address.district.

locality.description: City, town or post town. Maps to FHIR Address.city.

admin_area.description: The level-1 subdivision as written on an envelope — state, province, prefecture, emirate, oblast, county. Maps to FHIR Address.state. This is the postal spelling, not the reporting hierarchy; admin_unit_id is what reporting scopes match on.

admin_area_code.description: ISO 3166-2 code of admin_area, where the country's subdivisions are in the standard. The join between the postal address and the administrative tree, so the two cannot silently disagree.

postal_code.description: Validated against the country's pattern in the address-format pack when it has one. Maps to FHIR Address.postalCode.

plus_code.description: A full Google Open Location Code (Plus Code) for the facility. It is decoded offline and is especially useful where postal or street addressing is absent. Short codes are not accepted because they require a trusted nearby reference point.

sorting_code.description: Postal routing code used by a few countries, such as the French CEDEX. Has no FHIR Address field; exported as an extension or folded into the last line.

organization.description: Building, campus or department name that forms part of the address rather than the facility's registered name.

language_code.description: BCP 47 tag of the script the address is written in. An address may be recorded in a language other than the deployment's, and rendering it needs to know which.

admin_unit_id.description: Identifier of the AdminUnit this address sits under, as '<alpha3>:<level>:<code>'. The reporting geography; scope filters use it, never the postal fields.

geo_point.description: Derived facility coordinate with explicit precision and provenance. Patient residences use a separate schema and never carry this field.

formatted.description: The address rendered with the country's format string, newline separated. Derived and cached for display and export; never authoritative, and recomputed whenever a component changes.
